question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose "No error'.

My cognitive process is far most distinct than her ideologies.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of **"far most distinct."**
 
• The correct comparative phrase should be **"far more distinct."**
 
• "Most" is used for the superlative form**, which is incorrect in this context.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My cognitive process is **far more distinct** than her ideologies."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 4.
 
• **Option 2: "My cognitive process is"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "than her ideologies"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
